name.en: Joyful Easter Neumorphic UI Theme Pack

scope: Only active when body has easter-theme class or localStorage yamb_theme is easter.

packs.description: Pastel spring illustrated background with soft neumorphic overlays.
Theme-only neumorphic badges and pills icon pack for rooms, special actions and bottom menu buttons.
Neumorphic board, dice, score cells and game HUD without changing board dimensions.
Cards, typography, inputs, modals, notifications, chat, treasury, stats, rules and leaderboard contrast.

Easter-only final contrast layer for the shared end-of-board review, Tournament final ceremony, Next actions, Announce states, Treasury purchase action, in-game chat symbols, the online turn timer and H2H duel-count badges. Purple actions always use light cream ink; dark or light result surfaces never carry low-contrast purple text.

Easter-only Soft Clay header, four tabs, rewarded-video actions, themed Ducat marks beside the balance and +500 reward, store-state marks and bronze/silver/gold collection emblems; individual collectible trophies remain reserved for a separate Trophy Pack.

Easter-only professional Soft Clay tournament identity: header trophy, Information/Bracket/Hall of Fame tabs, registration and match-state symbols, all-time podium medals, champion trophy and finalist silver badge. Bracket geometry, rounds, names, avatars, scores, scheduling, rewards and swipe remain unchanged.

Easter-only professional Soft Clay Daily Challenge identity: inner room mark, task symbol, completed-result seal, shared rewarded-video mark for doubling and already-played-today state. Dice arrangement, scoring rules, timer, result, reward amount and functional controls remain unchanged; no placement medals are used.

Easter-only professional Soft Clay Leaderboard identity: room header mark, dedicated Global and Local list tab icons and a shared empty/loading illustration. A neutral reusable YotB gold, silver and bronze podium set is used for the first three places in both Leaderboard lists and the waiting-screen Top 3 panel. Period filters, avatars, player names, scores, data sources and ranking order remain unchanged.

Easter-only professional Soft Clay Statistics identity: room header, category marks for record, total games, wins, draws, losses, average, trophies, all-time points, ducats and H2H, plus a dedicated empty-H2H illustration. The H2H title uses one themed swords icon on the left without a duplicate legacy symbol on the right. Fire Streak has its own full Soft Clay room icon in both the Statistics card and leaderboard header; Trophies uses a distinct achievement cup and All-Time PTS uses a gold-star infinity mark. Power Index and Fire Streak each use their own internally consistent gold, silver and bronze podium set with lightning and flame identities. Charts, progress bars, avatars, values, POB/NER/POR colours, swipe and H2H card dimensions remain unchanged.

Easter-only professional Soft Clay Settings identity: room header and dedicated profile/account, sound effects, music, vibration, display/theme, language, terms and privacy mini-icons. SRB/ENG flags, switches, theme select, name field, Google avatar/account data, legal links and close control remain unchanged. No medals are used.

Easter-only professional Soft Clay Rules identity: room header and six page marks for Rules & Scoring, Statistics & Leaderboards, Multiplayer & Competitions, Communication, Ducats/Tokens/Treasury and Account/Privacy/Server. Every already-approved Easter room, action, state and category icon referenced by the rules is reused at compact text scale, including Online Players, Global Chat, Add Friend, Spectate, Duel, H2H, Fire Streak, All-Time PTS, Treasury tabs, rewarded video and connection states. Quarterly League rewards use the shared QL gold, silver and bronze medal set. Other themes retain their original symbols; text, numbering, lists, navigation, swipe, close control and functional dice illustrations remain unchanged.

Splash, quote, waiting and game-over screens plus matching 4.6-second Daily Challenge, Leaderboard, Statistics, Settings, Rules, Treasury, Tournament, Two Players Hotseat, Find Opponent, Invite Friend, Global Chat, Online Players, Quarterly League and Ducats & Undo room intros with immediately visible Soft Clay icons and left-to-right title waves. Quarterly League uses the selected full-colour YotB QL logo. The Tournament intro includes a live Easter-styled top-three panel with avatar, full player name and all-time tournament wins.

Soft Easter-specific motion for panel entrance, shimmer, hover and waiting pulse. Treasury and Tournament are complete purpose-built Blender models with no PNG front plane or alpha-shell shortcut. Every visible component is real geometry: the Treasury barrel lid, arches, layered structural frame, recessed panels, four-layer lock, faceted gem, ornate side ring, shaped floral relief and embossed coin; and the Tournament open cup, layered scroll handles, jewels, multi-ring medallion, star, dense shaped laurel, rounded petal band, stem, collars and decorated multi-tier pedestal. Soft Clay materials use matched cream, purple, turquoise and gold with AgX studio rendering. Each rotation pivot passes through the object's own vertical centre. Treasury follows 0/-18/0/+18/0 degrees and Tournament the exact opposite 0/+18/0/-18/0 path. Every one of the 61 transparent frames is supersampled at 768 px and reduced with a premultiplied-alpha pipeline before lossless WebP encoding at approximately 13 fps and 4.7 seconds, preventing dirty bands and colour halos around the moving silhouette. The same Blender animations are used at the original large size in the 4.6-second Treasury and Tournament room-entry sequences and restart from frame one on every entry; title spacing, title wave and Tournament top-three panel remain unchanged. No scale animation, narrowing compensation, lateral orbit or raster deformation is used. Main-menu icons retain the original 62 px visual slot; click targets, card dimensions and the Tournament notification badge remain fixed. The original static Soft Clay assets remain the prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Easter-styled loading, empty and fallback states using soft pills and symbolic icons.
Procedural Web Audio cues for Easter theme only: click, roll, score, announce, win, error and trophy.
Final screenshot set should cover splash, quote, main menu, board, leaderboard, settings, stats, treasury, chat, waiting and game-over.

rules: Do not change global theme icons as the base game style.
Keep Easter-specific styling isolated under body.easter-theme.
Do not change game board/card dimensions unless explicitly requested.
For future themes, create equivalent isolated packs instead of reusing Easter selectors globally.
Every two-player Easter game (online random, invite duel, spectator and Hotseat) uses the same freely swipeable vertical board pager and follows the active player only when the turn changes.
Treasury and Tournament use the same 4.6-second large-icon, fixed icon-to-title spacing and left-to-right title-wave intro rules as the Easter bottom-menu rooms.

Two Players Hotseat, Find Opponent and Invite Friend use the same 4.6-second large Soft Clay icon, fixed Riznica icon-to-title spacing and left-to-right uppercase title wave; Solo has no room intro until explicitly added later.
Global Chat, Online Players and Ducats & Undo use the same 4.6-second large Soft Clay icon, fixed Riznica icon-to-title spacing and left-to-right uppercase title wave.

The Easter Ducats & Undo intro keeps DUCATS centred on its original baseline, removes the conjunction, and renders UNDO LAST MOVE as a separate centred second line beneath it; the wave continues from the first line through the second without changing the 4.6-second duration, icon, icon scale or original first-line spacing.

Quarterly League uses the selected YotB QL rounded-diamond Soft Clay logo: theme-coloured as the only main-menu watermark and full-colour in the standard 4.6-second Easter room intro with fixed icon-to-title spacing and left-to-right uppercase title wave; the former circular crown watermark is removed.

Global Chat uses an Easter-only inner Soft Clay mini-pack: the approved chat mark in the header, an optically centred full 3D send icon and a discreet empty/loading-state illustration; its clean 44 px main-menu icon aligns exactly with the left edge of Online Players and sits approximately 1 mm lower, while the main-menu, room-header and 4.6-second intro variants share one newly rebuilt high-resolution master with pristine gold/purple surfaces and clean transparent edges; close, report, character count, online status and player avatars remain unchanged.

Online Players uses an Easter-only inner Soft Clay mini-pack: room icon in the header, Add Friend, Watch Game and Challenge to Duel action icons, plus a shared empty/loading illustration. The visible 3D bounds of all three action icons remain inside their unchanged 38 px button surfaces. Full player names wrap only at spaces between complete name parts, dynamically fit the widest complete word to the available width and never drop the final letter of a normal name or surname; narrow phones reduce spacing only, while avatar and action dimensions remain unchanged. The Easter search field stays directly below the fixed room header, searches the complete live server snapshot by full or partial name with diacritic-insensitive matching and never enters the bottom safe zone. Online cards render progressively in batches of 30 as the player scrolls, without imposing a total-player ceiling. Unavailable actions use dimmed versions of the same icons, and player status colours, data and close control remain unchanged.

Quarterly League uses an Easter-only complete inner Soft Clay pack: the YotB QL header mark; flat, fixed-size League and Hall of Fame tabs; clearly contrasted Easter active/inactive Medal and Champion subtabs; League, Hall of Fame, Medals and Champions tab icons; standardized Amateur, Pro, Master, Legend and Titan badges; a matching purple-and-gold ALL TIME badge; and one shared gold, silver and bronze QL medal set across standings, Hall of Fame and quarter-end notifications. All six rank and All Time badges are preloaded and decoded before the room intro, use eager rendering in their fixed slots and retry transient WebView loading failures. The global Quarterly League data layer loads every rank and All Time in batches of 50 with continuous scrolling and no total-entry ceiling, while progress calculation and fill, points, rank names, avatars, player names, rank swipe and reward logic remain unchanged.

The Easter Quarterly League focus overlay uses a theme-matched plum, blush and garden-green tint with a soft plum outer card shadow instead of neutral dark-grey dimming; card dimensions, placement, content and interaction remain unchanged.

Ducats and Undo uses an Easter-only inner Soft Clay mini-pack: separate Ducat and Undo Token icons in their tabs and active header, the same Soft Clay Ducat icon beside the Ducat balance and in the original compact +500 reward slot, and the same Soft Clay Undo Token icon in the original Your Tokens and compact +1 slots. A matching rewarded-video icon and a dedicated unavailable-ad icon complete the pack. Icon slots and layout dimensions, ducat/token balances, prices, ad availability state, button text, plus signs, quantities and close control remain unchanged; other themes retain their original Ducat and Token icons.

Solo uses an Easter-only end-screen identity: the approved Solo icon marks the Solo result, and a discreet Personal Best Soft Clay badge appears only when the new Solo score is strictly higher than the previous personal record. When a saved Solo game exists, the unchanged mode card replaces its normal icon/title content with fully visible, centred Easter Continue and New Game controls; the normal content never remains underneath them. Solo has no gold, silver or bronze placement medals. The board, dimensions, fields, selected dice skin, roll button, score and undo controls, formulas and gameplay icons remain unchanged; no extra table-intro label is added because it is not needed for clarity.

Two Players Hotseat keeps its existing 4.6-second Easter room intro and needs no duplicate table-header mark. When a saved Hotseat game exists, the unchanged mode card replaces its normal icon/title content with fully visible, centred Easter Continue and New Game controls; the normal content never remains underneath them. Its existing themed two-player presentation remains unchanged, while the shared end screen shows one Easter Soft Clay winner symbol only when there is a winner; draws show no winner symbol. No placement-medal set is used. Avatars, dual-board switching, swipe, automatic active-player following, active-player marker, board controls and scoring remain unchanged.

Find Opponent uses an Easter-only inner Soft Clay state pack across searching, opponent found, online duel and spectating: the approved globe in the waiting header, radar search, themed VS badge, opponent-found mark, existing approved spectate eye, and distinct disconnected/reconnected connection marks. Player cards, avatars, names, Power/POB/NER/POR, automatic and manual board paging, connection status colours and close control remain unchanged. Individual duels use no placement medals.

Invite Friend uses an Easter-only inner Soft Clay mini-pack across My Card, Friends List, Add Friend, Send Invitation, Invitation Sent and Invitation Accepted states: the approved invite mark in the waiting header, approved Add Friend mark, dedicated send/sent/accepted marks and a dedicated empty-list illustration. The unchanged full-size owner card uses two balanced contrasting panels. Both panels share exact horizontal baselines for avatar, fitted full name, Power, POB, NER and POR. The right panel resolves the real most-played H2H rival and refreshes that player's real public Power Index approximately every five seconds while the room remains open, using the live friends payload as an immediate source and a dedicated authenticated public-profile lookup for non-friends; no value is fabricated. It uses only the remaining lower space for a divider followed by the Greatest Rival label, without shifting any aligned data row. A truthful empty state is used when no duel exists. Every real friend card uses one contrasting Easter subcard with Power, POB, NER and POR in separate vertical rows. The complete friends row is lifted 1.5 mm above the phone safe zone, while Invite or Offline uses a compact 32 px action with a fixed 1.5 mm gap below the statistics subcard. Room code, close control, safe-zone protection and invitation logic remain unchanged.

Treasury uses an Easter-only inner Soft Clay pack: the approved Treasury header mark; dedicated Trophies, Dice Skins, Effects and Themes tab icons; the shared rewarded-video mark; the Easter Ducat mark beside both the live balance and +500 reward; purchased, active, locked and insufficient-ducats state icons; and bronze, silver and gold collection marks. Real dice-skin, theme and effect previews, prices, purchase logic and individual collectible trophies remain unchanged. Individual trophy replacement is deferred to a separate Treasury Trophy Pack.

Tournament uses an Easter-only professional inner Soft Clay pack: the approved trophy identity replaces the old header and Hall of Fame trophy only in Easter; Information, Bracket and Hall of Fame tabs have dedicated icons; registration, refund, locked registration, tournament start, active match and completed match have distinct state symbols; the all-time leaderboard alone uses gold, silver and bronze podium medals. A specific tournament result uses only the champion trophy and runner-up silver finalist badge, never an invented third-place award. Bracket lines and geometry, quarterfinal/semifinal/final layout, avatars, names, scores, match times, reward logic and phase swipe remain unchanged.

The Tournament top-three card is anchored 2 mm above the bottom safe zone and is visually independent from the main icon/title flow; the large Tournament icon and title keep the standard centered intro position, dimensions, title spacing and wave without being pushed downward by the card.
The Easter Tournament intro displays the real server-provided top three all-time tournament winners with avatar, full name and number of wins; it must never use fabricated ranking data.

Daily Challenge uses an Easter-only inner Soft Clay mini-pack: the approved room identity in the inner header, a dedicated task icon, a completed-challenge seal, the shared rewarded-video icon for doubling and a dedicated already-played-today state. Dice and their correct face arrangement, scoring rules, timer, result, reward amount and all functional controls remain unchanged. No placement medals are used until Daily Challenge has its own leaderboard.

Leaderboard uses an Easter-only Soft Clay header and dedicated Global and Local list tab icons, while Week, Month and All Time filters remain textual. Its first three positions and the waiting-screen Top 3 panel share one neutral reusable YotB podium pack with gold, silver and bronze medals. Empty and loading states use the dedicated Easter illustration. Avatars, player names, scores, global/local data separation and ranking order remain unchanged; future themes may reuse the neutral podium assets with theme-specific palette treatment.

Statistics uses an Easter-only Soft Clay header, category icons for record, total games, wins, draws, losses, average, trophies, ducats and H2H, and a dedicated empty-H2H illustration. Power Index uses one matching lightning gold/silver/bronze podium set; Fire Streak uses one matching flame gold/silver/bronze podium set. Charts and progress bars, opponent avatars, statistical values, POB/NER/POR colours, page swipe and detailed H2H card dimensions remain unchanged.

Settings uses an Easter-only Soft Clay header and dedicated profile/account, sound effects, music, vibration, display/theme, language, terms and privacy mini-icons. SRB and ENG flags, switches, theme selection, name field, Google avatar and account data, legal link targets and close control remain unchanged. Settings uses no placement medals.

Rules uses an Easter-only Soft Clay header and six page icons for Rules & Scoring, Statistics & Leaderboards, Multiplayer & Competitions, Communication, Ducats/Tokens/Treasury and Account/Privacy/Server. Every approved Easter room, action, state and category icon referenced by the rules is reused at compact text scale; legacy SVG and emoji counterparts are hidden only in Easter, while other themes retain them. Quarterly League reward medals use the same QL gold/silver/bronze pack. Rule text, numbering, lists, navigation arrows, swipe, close control and functional dice illustrations remain unchanged.

Easter contrast rule: purple action surfaces always use light cream text, never black; dark surfaces never use dark-purple text. The shared final-board review, Tournament final ceremony, Next buttons, Announce highlight/cancel states, Treasury Buy action and in-game chat controls follow this rule in every applicable game mode without changing dimensions or logic.

Every active two-player online match in Easter uses the same fixed-width red Soft Clay pill geometry as the spectator LIVE badge for its working turn countdown. My-turn, opponent-turn and urgent states keep identical dimensions and colour; urgent pulse and countdown logic remain unchanged, while reconnection messages retain their wider dedicated layout.

Statistics H2H rival cards keep the duel-count badge in its original lower-right avatar slot and original dimensions, but Easter renders it as a purple Soft Clay pill with light cream numerals and a light border instead of purple with black ink.
